excavation_context.character_description: Adult female grad student museum preparator, short blonde hair, lightly tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a white lab coat, white skirt, and light blue pumps.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_2 is using an automated dental buffer to clean a broad armor scute of a Polacanthus. The heavy scute is securely embedded in a square block of dense, mottled red claystone matrix. Fine red clay dust coats her work surface under crisp white laboratory ambient lighting. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
